title: Pure Egyptian God
summary: Pure Egyptian God strategy uniting the three DIVINE Divine-Beast deities—Slifer the Sky Dragon, Obelisk the Tormentor, and The Winged Dragon of Ra—with the versatile Slime engine and Soul Crossing. By generating three Tributes through Reactor Slime, Egyptian God Slime, or tributing the opponent's entire field with Soul Crossing, the deck effortlessly fields the Creator Gods with full protective backing.

summary.title: Starters
points: Reactor Slime summons two Slime Tokens during your Main Phase to immediately provide tribute material, and tributes itself during the Battle Phase to Set Metal Reflect Slime from hand, Deck, or GY.

Guardian Slime Special Summons itself from hand when you take battle or effect damage, and searches any Spell/Trap mentioning The Winged Dragon of Ra (such as Ancient Chant or Soul Crossing) when sent to the GY.
Soul Crossing is a Quick-Play Spell that immediately Tribute Summons a Divine-Beast monster during either player's Main Phase by tributing monsters from either player's field.
Ancient Chant searches The Winged Dragon of Ra from Deck or GY, grants an additional Tribute Summon, and banishes from GY to grant Ra the combined original ATK/DEF of its Tributes.

summary.title: Opening: Reactor Slime + Soul Crossing
steps: Normal Summon Reactor Slime and activate its effect to Special Summon two Slime Tokens to your field.
Tribute Reactor Slime and the two Slime Tokens to Tribute Summon Obelisk the Tormentor or Slifer the Sky Dragon.
Alternatively, activate Soul Crossing on the opponent's turn, tributing 3 of their monsters to Tribute Summon Slifer the Sky Dragon to your field.
Slifer immediately triggers its continuous effect, reducing the ATK of any monster the opponent summons in Attack Position by 2000 and destroying it if its ATK drops to 0.
Set The Revived Sky God or Fist of Fate to provide unchainable negation and massive card draw.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Slifer the Sky Dragon gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand, and automatically reduces the ATK of every monster the opponent Normal or Special Summons in Attack Position by 2000, destroying them if their ATK reaches 0.
Obelisk the Tormentor has 4000 original ATK/DEF, cannot be targeted by Spells, Traps, or card effects, and tributes 2 monsters you control to destroy all monsters the opponent controls.
The Winged Dragon of Ra pays LP until you have 100 remaining to gain that much ATK/DEF, and pays 1000 LP to destroy any monster on the field.

The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode tributes 3 monsters your opponent controls to summon itself to their field, breaking unbreakable boards before returning to your field to summon Ra with 4000 ATK/DEF.
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix is an unaffected 4000 ATK form that revives from the GY when Ra falls and pays 1000 LP to send an opponent's monster to the GY without targeting.
Egyptian God Slime counts as 1, 2, or 3 Tributes for a monster that requires 3 Tributes, and prevents the opponent from targeting other monsters for attacks or card effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Soul Crossing allows you to Tribute Summon a Divine-Beast using the opponent's monsters at Quick-Play speed on either player's turn.
The Revived Sky God cannot be negated: revives Slifer the Sky Dragon from your GY and forces both players to draw until they have 6 cards in hand.
Fist of Fate cannot be negated: while you control Obelisk, negates an opponent's monster's effects, destroys it, and wipes all Spells and Traps the opponent controls.

Mound of the Bound Creator protects Level 10 or higher monsters from being targeted or destroyed by card effects, inflicts 1000 burn damage when they destroy monsters, and searches a DIVINE monster when destroyed.

allow.Metal Reflect Slime: Trap Monster summoned directly from the Deck by Reactor Slime that tributes itself during the Battle Phase to cheat out Egyptian God Slime.

main: Slifer the Sky Dragon
Egyptian God card that gains 1000 ATK/DEF per card in your hand and reduces the ATK of all monsters the opponent summons in Attack Position by 2000, destroying them if their ATK hits 0.
Obelisk the Tormentor
4000 ATK/DEF Egyptian God card that cannot be targeted by Spells, Traps, or effects and tributes 2 monsters to destroy all monsters the opponent controls.
The Winged Dragon of Ra
Egyptian God card that converts your LP into ATK/DEF via Ancient Chant and pays 1000 LP to destroy any monster on the field.
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode
Tributes 3 monsters your opponent controls to Normal Summon itself to their field, then tributes itself to summon a 4000 ATK/DEF Winged Dragon of Ra from your hand or Deck.
The Winged Dragon of Ra - Immortal Phoenix
4000 ATK/DEF form that Special Summons itself from the GY when Ra is sent from the field to the GY and pays 1000 LP to send a monster to the GY without targeting.
Reactor Slime
Summons 2 Slime Tokens during your Main Phase for a 3-Tribute Summon, and tributes itself during the Battle Phase to set Metal Reflect Slime from hand, Deck, or GY.
Guardian Slime
Special Summons itself from the hand when you take battle or effect damage, and searches any Spell/Trap mentioning The Winged Dragon of Ra when sent from hand or field to the GY.
Soul Crossing
Quick-Play Spell that immediately Tribute Summons 1 Divine-Beast monster during the Main Phase by Tributing monsters from EITHER field (including your opponent's monsters!).
Ancient Chant
Searches The Winged Dragon of Ra from Deck or GY, grants an extra Tribute Summon this turn, and banishes from GY to give Ra the combined original ATK/DEF of its Tributes.
The True Name
Declares the top card of your Deck; if correct, adds it to your hand and adds or Special Summons 1 DIVINE monster directly from your Deck.
Mound of the Bound Creator
Field Spell that makes Level 10 or higher monsters on the field untargetable and indestructible by card effects, and searches a DIVINE monster when destroyed.
Millennium Revelation
Continuous Spell that sends a Divine-Beast from hand to GY to add Monster Reborn from Deck/GY, and allows Monster Reborn to revive The Winged Dragon of Ra.
The Revived Sky God
Normal Trap whose activation cannot be negated; revives Slifer the Sky Dragon from your GY and makes both players draw until they have 6 cards in hand.
Fist of Fate
Quick-Play Spell whose activation cannot be negated; while you control Obelisk, negates an opponent's Effect Monster and destroys it plus all Spells/Traps they control.
Metal Reflect Slime
Set from Deck by Reactor Slime; summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 3000 DEF to immediately transform into Egyptian God Slime.
extra: Level 10 Fusion boss summoned by Tributing a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or Metal Reflect Slime); counts as 1 or 3 Tributes for an Egyptian God, cannot be destroyed by battle, and protects your other monsters from attacks and targeting.
